post.caption:
A bank loan does not transfer money out of a vault. It creates a new deposit that did not exist a moment earlier, and that deposit gets spent, redeposited and lent against again. Which is why most money in circulation exists only as bank records, and why bank runs are possible at all: if everyone withdraws at once the cash genuinely is not there, and never was. That is exactly what deposit insurance exists to cover.
